public_rationale: The antecedent is documented: novice participants accepted generated code with little review. Separate security testing also found vulnerabilities. These records make the concern plausible, but do not establish the full causal forecast about substantial spaghetti code and security consequences from beginner overdependence. No qualifying conclusive event was found. With no deadline, the forecast remains open.
limitations: The novice evidence is a preprint and a short controlled exercise.
Security benchmark failures cannot establish the behavior or experience of real users.
No numerical threshold for the amount or maintainability of code was stated.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: In some instances, beginners' overdependence on AI coding tools will produce large amounts of hard-to-maintain spaghetti code and create security problems.

statement.excerpt: In some instances, an overdependence on the new tools will lead beginners to make giant mountains of difficult-to-maintain spaghetti code; security will be an issue as well.

from_speaker: an overdependence on the new tools
giant mountains of difficult-to-maintain spaghetti code
security will be an issue as well
our_interpretation: Despite its causal content, 'will lead' makes this an existential forecast with no stated deadline.
The plain reading of overdependence is accepting substantial generated code without enough understanding or review to detect and repair problems.
'Giant mountains' means substantial accumulated code; 'spaghetti code' means tangled structure that materially impedes maintenance. No numerical threshold is supplied.
Both maintenance and security consequences must be established, but they need not occur in the same project.
criteria.support_condition: One or more documented post-publication cases establish that beginners' excessive reliance caused substantial hard-to-maintain code and security problems.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that the stated causal outcome cannot occur within the claimed class. Successful projects or a period without documented failures do not refute an open-ended existential forecast.
